newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends steady vs basket, up vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends steady vs basket, up vs dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket and a shade firmer against the dollar on Tuesday, dealers said.
The Hungarian unit finished right on the central bank's resistance level at 197.45/50 against the dolar compared with an opening of 197.55/60.
Traders saw no reason why the forint should leave the NBH's resistance level in the near future.
"The dollar does not have a clear trend and there is no reason why market players should start selling other currencies," said Istvan Hideg of Takarebank.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
